levels.starting_evidence: incident window, workflow, observables, progressive hints

levels.withheld: all pivots, state classifications, and remediation

hints.text: Start with runtime tool-control decisions in the incident window; keep external evidence adjacent.
Pivot candidate run IDs into memory, MCP authorization, execution, and outcome event families.
Inspect sequence, event.name, content.hash, memory.id, source_run_id, requested/allowed scope, decision, reason, and operation outcome.
Run Q-L9-DISCOVER, bind Q-L9-TIMELINE to each candidate, then compare with Q-L9-COMPARE after recording your hypothesis.

hypothesis_decomposition: Did equivalent content persist and later recall?
Did behavior form a privileged request?

failure_states.hec_unavailable: EXPORT PATH UNAVAILABLE — local runtime does not become SAFE
failure_states.incomplete_run: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE — reconcile local and distinct indexed events
failure_states.missing_event: NOT OBSERVED — do not infer prevention
failure_states.external_evidence_unavailable: EXTERNAL PLANE UNAVAILABLE — runtime conclusion unchanged
failure_states.ambiguous_candidates: NARROW AND PIVOT — candidate is not incident
